instruction: Examine the spreadsheet on the desktop, which contains a record of books read in 2022. Take the website https://howlongtoread.com/ as a reference to identify the three books with the slowest reading pace, measured in words per day. Calculate the average rating of these three books. I have an empty document named 'book_list_result.docx' on the desktop; please open it and record the average rating there.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding the 3 slowest books and calculating their average rating. Verified with Python: Top 3 slowest are 'Out of the Silent Planet' (1328.89 words/day, rating 3.0), 'Silence' (1984.27 words/day, rating 5.0), and 'Song of Solomon' (2105.46 words/day, rating 5.0). Average rating = (3.0 + 5.0 + 5.0) / 3 = 4.333... Evaluator checks if DOCX contains a number matching 4.33 within tolerance 0.05.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary: 1.0 if numeric value ~4.33 found in DOCX (tolerance 0.05), 0.0 otherwise
